name: complex
description: Demo database for complex types in PostgreSQL. One table with one column per type shape: arrays, composite types, jsonb.

attributes.name: tags
attributes.label: Tags
attributes.description: List of text values; elements are addressed 1-based

attributes.name: scores
attributes.label: Scores
attributes.description: List of integers; numeric elements for lambda arithmetic

attributes.name: vec
attributes.label: Vector
attributes.description: Array of three doubles; PostgreSQL arrays have no fixed size

attributes.name: matrix
attributes.label: Matrix
attributes.description: One two-dimensional array of two rows of three doubles, not an array of arrays; the first index selects the row

attributes.name: dims
attributes.label: Dimensions
attributes.description: Flat composite type cx_dims of width and height

attributes.name: address
attributes.label: Address
attributes.description: Composite type cx_address holding a nested composite (cx_geo) and a list (phones)

attributes.name: attrs
attributes.label: Attributes
attributes.description: Map as a JSON object with text keys; PostgreSQL has no map type

attributes.name: counts
attributes.label: Counts
attributes.description: Map as a JSON object with numeric values; PostgreSQL has no map type

attributes.name: lookup
attributes.label: Lookup
attributes.description: Map as a JSON object; the integer keys are text, as JSON has no other

attributes.name: items
attributes.label: Items
attributes.description: Array of composite type cx_item: sku, quantity, price and a list of options

attributes.name: events
attributes.label: Events
attributes.description: Array of composite type cx_event with temporal fields

attributes.name: deep
attributes.label: Deep
attributes.description: A list of maps whose values are structures holding a list and a map of lists; jsonb as a whole, since it contains maps

attributes.name: doc
attributes.label: Document
attributes.description: jsonb document; JSON paths count from 0, arrays from 1

attributes.name: odd
attributes.label: Odd
attributes.description: Composite type cx_odd with a mixed-case field name that needs quoting

links.name: same_check
links.comment: both tables refer to the same data record
